guesses.breed: American Pit Bull Terrier / American Staffordshire Terrier
guesses.reason: Short, sleek blue-gray coat, broad blocky skull, defined stop, and rose/half-folded ears are classic pit bull–type traits.
The solid gray coat, slightly loose lips, and fairly deep muzzle on a large-listed dog hint at some mastiff-type influence.
The softer, slightly longer muzzle and gentle expression could reflect some retriever ancestry.

breed.appearance: A large, short-coated dog with a solid slate blue-gray coat, slightly lighter and grizzled around the muzzle and brow, with a dark gray-black nose. He has a broad, rounded head, a medium-length squared muzzle, soft folded rose ears that tip backward, and warm, deep brown almond-shaped eyes with a sweet, slightly droopy gaze. In this photo he's snuggled into a fluffy cream blanket wearing a navy blue harness with gray reflective stripes.
breed.fun_fact: Pit bull–type dogs are famous for their goofy, affectionate personalities and love nothing more than being a cuddly couch companion!
